items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Danny Barclan; the name is only mentioned by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think she's kind of Danny Barclan. She sang, she made a record with, uh, Piron? Piron, I think, I think she's kind of Danny Barclan. Yeah.

And they had Lila Bolden, she recorded back there then. You ever heard of her? Bolden? Wasn't there a lot of Syracuse? Yeah. Did you know, uh, or at another profession? Yeah. They had two professions, a lot of them.
